comment: Official secureblue GitHub requests we shipped first. Live open/closed + closing PR refresh at Pages. Never drop an item when they close it. If they ship after us, set nothing — the generator moves the card. After you review their patch: stock_reviewed=keep (ours stays) OR adopted:{on, note, commit} (we copied theirs because it was better). Do not auto-copy. Do not add a FEAT we did not ship. Do not claim kernel/UKI/ARM.

items.title: [FEAT] Add more filesystem permissions to Harden Flatpak command
items.we: Extra xdg folders plus host-root cut by default. Not host-os (hardened_malloc needs host-os:ro).

items.title: [FEAT] Allow blocking flatpaks from creating record streams
items.we: Pulse and PipeWire capture blocked for Flatpaks, independent of folder lockdown. Native speakers stay.

items.title: [FEAT] add network fs toggle
items.we: NFS and CIFS client modules blacklisted. Stock already masks the NFS server; we never unmask the server.

items.title: [FEAT] Make disk encryption opt-out instead of opt-in in anaconda
items.we: Empty-disk Anaconda starts with LUKS on. You can still untick Encrypt.

items.title: [FEAT] Report installed Flatpak browsers in `ujust audit-secureblue`
items.we: ujust audit-unwoke warns if a Flatpak web browser is installed, and fails on browserless.
items.revert: Hygiene, not a lock. Uninstall the Flatpak if it should not be there.

items.title: Set higher default memory parameter for LUKS in ISOs
items.we: Argon2id memory cost 2 GiB (RFC 9106) on the live ISO and /usr/etc/cryptsetup.conf.
items.revert: Weaker if you format LUKS yourself without that conf

items.title: [FEAT] audit-secureblue should check flatpak session bus policy
items.we: ujust audit-unwoke warns if Flatpak session-bus, system-bus, or org.freedesktop.Flatpak is allowed.

items.title: [BUG] ISO installer uses unencrypted NTP
items.we: Live ISO chrony uses NTS (time.cloudflare.com, nts.ntp.se), not fedora NTP pool in the clear.
items.revert: Anaconda Time & Date still lets you pick servers

items.title: [FEAT] DHCP Anonymization profile
items.we: RFC 7844 leftovers: dhcp-send-release and dhcp-iaid=mac, plus hostname off we already shipped.

items.title: [FEAT] Reduce the amount of trusted CAs
items.we: Blocklist Fedora roots that are not Mozilla website-trusted. Some gov/old CAs fail.

items.title: RAM disk protection?
items.we: noexec,nosuid,nodev on /dev/shm and /tmp. Payloads in RAM cannot exec.

items.title: [FEAT] toggle ujust SHSTK/IBT
items.we: glibc SHSTK and IBT tunables default on (x86_64). Stock still asks for a toggle.

items.title: [FEAT] chmod 700 .boot /usr/src /lib/modules /usr/lib/modules
items.we: /boot is mode 700. ostree /usr is not chmod'd at runtime.
